mandatory.label: Ontario electrical contractor licence held by the bidder

weighted.label: Price
weighted.rule: 100 * lowest eligible price / bidder price; price above ceiling -> ineligible

weighted.label: Timeline
weighted.rule: 100 * shortest eligible weeks / bidder weeks; weeks above max or not stated -> 0

weighted.label: Warranty
weighted.rule: 50% panel (25 yrs or more = 100, else years/25) + 50% workmanship (years / longest eligible workmanship years)

weighted.label: Team and approach
weighted.rule: 25 points each: named lead, crew described, safety plan, monitoring plan
